topics.title: llama.cpp runs Jev-style decision models locally (/v1/systemone)
topics.why: b11361 (Fri Oct 2 ~6:53pm CT) adds /v1/systemone to llama-server for laya, julia-1, lev, openjev (+vision), kev. ggml-org/OpenJev-GGUF: Q4_K_M 19GB, Q8_0 28.6GB, fits a single RTX 5090.

topics.title: llama.cpp speculative decoding holds up at temp > 0
topics.why: b11368 makes simple-draft and MTP drafting probabilistic with rejection-sampling verify; b11387 fixes n-gram drafts at temp > 0. Weekend CUDA work: fused shared experts into MMVQ, whole-tile FlashAttention, MoE MMQ fault fix. Nightlies through b11412 (~5:30am CT Mon).
